AlertDefinition.name: Cost Expiring
AlertDefinition.Source:
select cr.costRecordKey, s, item, item.itemNumber, sup.businessEntityName, cr.costType.costTypeKey, toSite.siteDescription, fromSite.siteDescription, cr.status, cr.effectiveToDt from PcmCostRecord cr, PcmAlertSubscription s join cr.sourcingLane sl join sl.item item left outer join sl.supplier sup left outer join sl.toSite toSite left outer join sl.fromSite fromSite where cr.status = 'APPROVED' and cr.effectiveToDt >= trunc(sysdate) and cr.effectiveToDt <= trunc(sysdate) + to_number(:days)
and not exists (select cr2 from PcmCostRecord cr2 where cr2.sourcingLane = sl and cr2.costType = cr.costType and cr2.effectiveFromDt = cr.effectiveToDt + 1 and cr2.status = cr.status)
and exists (select a.item from ItemAssignment a where a.item = item and s.user.userId = a.userId and s.alertType = 'CostExpiring' and s.subscribeFlag = 1

Detail.Label: @{name} alert for @{item}
Detail.Body: @{state} @{costType} cost record for item @{item} responsibility @{responsibility} will expire @{expDate}

List.name: CostExpiringResponsibility
List.Expression: exists (select 1 from s.options o where o.optionId = 'Responsibility' and (lower(o.optionValue) = lower('All') or lower(o.optionValue) = lower(a.responsibility)))

List.name: CostExpiringCostType
List.Expression: exists (select 1 from s.options o where o.optionId = 'CostType' and (lower(o.optionValue) = lower('All') or lower(o.optionValue) = lower(cr.costType.costTypeKey)))

List.name: CostExpiringToSite
List.Expression: exists (select 1 from s.options o where o.optionId = 'ToSite' and (lower(o.optionValue) = lower('All') or to_char(toSite.siteKey) = o.optionValue or toSite.parentSite = (select site from Site site where to_char(site.siteKey) = o.optionValue)))

MultiText.name: CostExpiringSupplierName
MultiText.Expression: (exists (select 1 from s.options o where o.optionId = 'Supplier' and lower(sup.businessEntityName) = lower(o.optionValue)) or not exists (select 1 from s.options o where o.optionId = 'Supplier'))

List.name: CostExpiringProductState
List.Expression: exists (select 1 from s.options o where o.optionId = 'ProductState' and (lower(o.optionValue) = lower('All') or lower(o.optionValue) = lower(sl.productState)))

List.name: CostExpiringExpiringDays
List.Expression: exists (select 1 from s.options o where o.optionId = 'ExpiringDays' and (o.optionValue = :days))
